jobs.title: Sr. Developer Advocate, AI and Machine Learning
Sr. Developer Advocate, AI and Machine Learning

reading.body:
The entire developer relations and education slice of AI hiring in this dataset is two identical Databricks postings, one in San Francisco and one in Seattle, both dated August 14, 2026.

The two entries share a title, a company, a category, and a posting date. That is more consistent with one role opened in two locations than with two independent hiring decisions. Both came from a company career board rather than an aggregator, so they record what a single employer chose to post, not what the market is doing. Developer relations and education is the function that teaches outside developers how to use a platform, which makes it a signal about how many people a company needs to explain its tools rather than to build them.

What the data does not cover matters more than what it does. There is no salary, no seniority spread beyond the "Sr." prefix, no second employer, and no earlier or later snapshot to compare against. The postings are roughly a month older than the build date, and nothing here says whether they were filled or remain open. The source list includes federal, aggregated, remote, and European job boards, but none of them contributed a posting to this function, so a count of two describes the collection rather than the size of the field. Nothing in these records speaks to compute, buildings, or power.
